name: Pharmacology Focus
description: Antibiotics, antivirals, antifungals, anti-inflammatories, IOP-lowering agents, mydriatics, cycloplegics, anesthetics, dry eye drugs, and systemic medications with ocular effects.

episodes.title: Pharmacokinetics of the Eye: The Barriers to Drug Delivery
episodes.description: Corneal and conjunctival absorption, the tear washout, and why drop frequency matters.

episodes.title: Topical Antibiotics: The Spectrum and the Stewardship
episodes.description: From erythromycin to fluoroquinolones — matching the drug to the organism and the severity.

episodes.title: Fortified Antibiotics: When the Bug Outruns the Drop
episodes.description: Compounding vancomycin and tobramycin, the dosing schedule, and the inpatient-versus-outpatient line.

episodes.title: Antivirals for Ocular HSV and HZV
episodes.description: Topical trifluridine, oral acyclovir and valacyclovir, and the dose and duration for each.

episodes.title: Antifungals: The Limited Armamentarium
episodes.description: Natamycin, amphotericin, and voriconazole — when fungi threaten the cornea and the options are few.

episodes.title: Acanthamoeba: The Biguanides That Work
episodes.description: PHMB and chlorhexidine, the painful dosing schedule, and the months-long treatment course.

episodes.title: Topical Steroids: The Power and the Peril
episodes.description: Prednisolone, loteprednol, fluorometholone — the potency ladder and the IOP and infection risks.

episodes.title: NSAID Drops: The Steroid-Sparing Anti-Inflammatory
episodes.description: Ketorolac, nepafenac, bromfenac — the post-op and the cystoid macular edema role.

episodes.title: Allergy Drops: Antihistamines and Mast Cell Stabilizers
episodes.description: Olopatadine and the dual-action class, the onset and duration, and the seasonal versus perennial choice.

episodes.title: Mydriatics and Cycloplegics: The Dilating Drops
episodes.description: Tropicamide, phenylephrine, cyclopentolate, atropine — the onset, duration, and the cycloplegia strength.

episodes.title: Anesthetic Drops: The Diagnostic Tool, Not the Therapy
episodes.description: Proparacaine and tetracaine — why they are for diagnosis only and the abuse that destroys corneas.

episodes.title: Glaucoma Drops: The Prostaglandin Analogues
episodes.description: Latanoprost, travoprost, bimatoprost — the once-daily dosing, the side effects, and the color change.

episodes.title: Beta-Blockers: The Systemic Caution
episodes.description: Timolol — the asthma and bradycardia contraindications and the bedtime dosing tip.

episodes.title: Alpha-2 Agonists: Brimonidine and the CNS Risk
episodes.description: The IOP effect, the allergy rate, and the pediatric apnea warning.

episodes.title: Carbonic Anhydrase Inhibitors: Topical and Oral
episodes.description: Dorzolamide and acetazolamide — the sulfonamide cross-reactivity and the oral side effects.
